text:
anya: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone rollup. Please drop: what shipped this sprint, any slips, and blockers I should escalate. I’ll assemble the summary for the exec snapshot.

mike: Frontend shipped the new milestone filters and ownership badges yesterday. Dashboard filter perf looks stable. Rolling to canary now. :tada:

lina: Backend shipped the rollout endpoint + routing policy support. Need to follow up on telemetry retention (we're at 7d, product wants 30d). Not blocking for rollout but flagging for infra planning.

devon: CR ping @lina on PR #482 — large-batch stress test failing on our staging GPU pool. Logs show KV cache thrash:
```
OOM during kv_cache_alloc: unable to allocate 512MB
```
I pushed a sled fix that reduces batch size, but want a review before we land.

lina: looking now, devon. Might be quantization memory spike; will try a repro with smaller seq len.

samir: Ops note — Dedicated capacity autoscaler hit a spike yesterday, we temporarily exceeded commit for one customer. I raised a support ticket and set a temporary burst cap. We should clarify Dedicated SLAs if autoscaler policies change.

anya: Thanks — mike/lina/devon: can you each add a one-sentence risk and the owner for follow-up? I’ll include in the OKR status doc.

mike: Risk: filter rollout may show stale counts for early users. Owner: mike. Next: add realtime invalidation job.

lina: Risk: telemetry retention gap could block audits. Owner: lina + infra. Next: proposal for retention tiering by EOD Fri.

devon: Risk: staging OOM could indicate production risk under heavy batching. Owner: devon. Next: land small-batch fallback + add perf regression test.

anya: Great. samir — any downstream deps (security, sales enablement) we should ping?

samir: Security wants the telemetry plan + HSM integration notes before we mark Private-ready. Sales needs a one-pager on Dedicated burst behavior for largest accounts. I can draft both early next week.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for frontend filters started 2026-03-15T18:03Z — 2% traffic. Monitoring: no error rate increase.

anya: OK — I'll stitch this into the quarter rollup. Plan: ship summary by EOD tomorrow, list owners and next steps, and call out two escalations (telemetry retention, batching OOM). If anyone has docs to attach, drop links here.

mike: attaching the rollout notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/frontend-filters-rollout

lina: adding retention proposal draft to the thread in 1hr.

devon: PR #482 link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/482 — marked WIP until review.

anya: Perfect — thanks everyone. If you want me to call a 15m async huddle, react with :thumbsup:.

mike: :thumbsup:

lina: :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup:
